Mean |P_robust - P_percentile| = 0.144 with 36 cells disagreeing by more than 0.5, so the two methods are reported separately rather than pooled. OF THE 53 CELLS IN THE HEADLINE TOP 20%, ONLY 28 STAY THERE IN AT LEAST 80% OF DRAWS AND 12 ARE ON THE WRONG SIDE OF A COIN FLIP. CHECKER SUBAGENT (section 3.1): it built its own implementation from the spec with its own seeds and AGREED on every headline number -- 27/49/189 split (mine 28/48/189 after a bug fix it prompted), mean method gap 0.145 vs 0.144, 36 cells disagreeing by >0.5 (exact match), 12 of 53 below a coin flip (exact match), and the three spot cells matching within Monte Carlo error. IT FOUND A REAL BUG, now fixed as D23: D6b's guarantee that an empty cell scores Priority 0 held only under robust min-max; under percentile rank the 21 empty cells normalised to 0.0379, so half the draws violated the invariant. population is now declared structural_zero in config.
